rooms.name: Standard Room
rooms.description: Comfortable guest room with air conditioning, Smart TV, high-speed Wi-Fi, and en-suite bathroom. Standard tariff: 1-2 guests at PKR 5,000/night; 3 guests at PKR 7,000/night.
rooms.longDescription: The Standard Room at The Nest Stays provides a serene, spotless haven equipped with comfortable queen/double bedding, individual air conditioning, a modern Smart TV, high-speed Wi-Fi, fresh linens, plush towels, and daily housekeeping. Standard tariff: PKR 5,000/night for 1-2 guests; PKR 7,000/night for 3 guests. Applicable taxes included.

settings.address: Street Number 3, opposite UCP Mufti Town, near Qalma Chownk, Mufti Colony, Gujranwala, 52250, Pakistan

policies.cancellation: Free cancellation up to 48 hours before check-in. Cancellations within 48 hours are subject to property policy. Applicable taxes are included in room tariff.
policies.payment: Applicable taxes are included in the room tariff. Pay at the property upon arrival, or transfer an advance deposit to property-configured accounts. All advance payments undergo manual verification.
houseRules: Check-in is at 2:00 PM; Check-out is strictly at 12:00 PM
Valid Original CNIC / Passport required for all adult guests at check-in
Quiet hours observed after 11:00 PM for the peaceful comfort of all guests
Non-smoking rooms; designated outdoor areas available
In-room refreshments (mini-bar) are optional and charged separately upon consumption
